short_description: Inventory valuation pipeline failed - March close at risk

work_notes.note: Valuation feed status returned failed at 08:15. No output partition for 2026-03. Raising at P2 - month-end close depends on this job.
Initial assessment: overnight Helios ERP outage. Source extract appears incomplete. Treating as upstream availability issue pending confirmation.
ERP outage ruled out. Helios logs show no interruption during the valuation window 02:00-04:00. Reverting to pipeline-side investigation.

Root cause confirmed. The legacy-to-new product hierarchy mapping in Merchandising Hub is stale. 18,412 SKUs have no mapped category node, so on-hand stock for those SKUs cannot be valued. This is the same mapping table implicated in the November 2025 failure.
Manual hierarchy mapping override applied for the 18,412 affected SKUs so the period can be valued. Override is not persisted to the master.
Valuation completed for 2026-03. Resolving. Problem record PRB0004192 raised to carry the underlying control issue.
Review outcome: underlying failure is a control failure, not a pipeline defect. The mapping table has no registered owner and no required reviewer. Remediation raised as SCRG-4471 and SCRG-4472.

close_notes: Valuation completed via manual hierarchy mapping override. Underlying control failure carried to PRB0004192 and remediated under SCRG-4471 and SCRG-4472.
